mechanism: Eslicarbazepine induces CYP3A4 and may increase modafinil metabolism, potentially reducing modafinil efficacy; modafinil may inhibit CYP2C19 and affect eslicarbazepine levels.
action: Monitor modafinil efficacy and consider dose adjustment if needed; monitor eslicarbazepine levels and seizure control; assess for breakthrough seizures or reduced wakefulness.
